com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.passkeys.Passkey

Packages that use Passkey
Package
Description
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.api.web.passkeys
Passkeys (WebAuthn): the factor, the chain wiring, the login and second-factor fragments, the account API and the account page.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.passkeys
Use cases that manage the passkeys (WebAuthn credentials) of a user: list, rename and delete, whether the user has one (a second factor enrolment query), and the relying party settings.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.domain.passkeys
Passkeys (WebAuthn credentials): the descriptive model of a registered credential, the port that lists, renames and deletes them, and the exception for a credential that does not exist.
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.infrastructure.persistence.passkeys
PostgreSQL implementation of the passkey port over the user_credentials and user_entities tables of Spring Security's official WebAuthn schema, plus the beans of Spring's own JDBC credential and user entity repositories that the WebAuthn filters use.
